scope: Windows integrity/startup + node-visibility + safe-upgrade hotfix; Linux R14 unchanged
reportedFailure: Application installed but did not open; ui-error.txt contained APP_FILE_CHANGED: View.xaml.

rootCause.details: v4.3.0 manifest hashes were correct for canonical LF source. The Windows build working tree contained CRLF bytes for View.xaml and directdpi/hosts.txt, and Inno Setup packaged those raw working-copy bytes. Startup integrity correctly rejected the installed CRLF View.xaml.
rootCause.finalInterpretation: The integrity guard behaved correctly; the package/manifest contract did not match the exact bytes installed on Windows.

change.manifest: All protected app-manifest entries are generated/verified against the exact raw app bytes packaged by the Windows installer; build fails closed on any hash/size mismatch.
change.ci: Fresh-install CI launches the installed UI and fails on a missing child UI process or ui-error.txt.
change.nodeUi: NodeList MinHeight=190, explicit DataGrid header/cell/text styles and row sizing; advanced node metadata is collapsed by default.
change.upgradeGuard: Connected/unknown/live-parent runtimes remain fail-closed; only Free Net Hub-owned dead-parent listeners with an explicitly disconnected session may be cleaned before upgrade.

nodeUiLive.interpretation: Backend rows were present; the defect was node-grid layout/readability, now closed by minimum grid height, explicit cell/header text styling, and collapsed advanced metadata.

exactNextAction: Rebuild/verify final public tree, commit/push exact candidate, then require hosted fresh-install + installed UI launch + aggregate CI before v4.3.1 publication.
reportedFailures: Public v4.3.0 installed but did not open; ui-error.txt contained APP_FILE_CHANGED: View.xaml.
Nodes backend contained 2000 entries but NodeList was squeezed to a near-zero-height strip.
First v4.3.1 live upgrade exited 7 because disconnected orphan WARP/CFON listeners were treated as active.
